caption: The drawing depicts a pewter lamp set against a plain background. The lamp has a rounded, iridescent glass reservoir colored with light purples, blues, and pink tones, positioned near the top of the object. Two dark, upward-pointing wick holders or burners protrude from the top of the reservoir. Supporting the reservoir is a decorative metal collar adorned with detailed acanthus leaf motifs. The lamp stem features a series of turned, cylindrical sections in a metallic gray, consistent with the pewter material, and it rests on a wide, rounded base joined by a slightly tapered section above. The overall shading employs various tones of gray with white highlights, suggesting a reflective metallic texture for most of the lamp, and the color accents are reserved for the glass component. There are minor annotations, including the words “PEWTER LAMP CASE #2 18010-1904 Joseph Lide” written at the lower left, and some faint sketch lines, notes, and small numbers visible around the central illustration. The composition is centered on the page with a thin rectangular outline framing the drawing.
title: Lamp
